path.description: The path at which to create the files, relative to the current workspace.

baseApiPath.description: Path for base API file. For Angular: defaults to path + '/_api-base.service.ts'. For RTK: defaults to 'th-common/store/api-base.ts'.

swaggerSchemaUrl.description: Source of the OpenAPI/Swagger schema: an http(s) URL, or a path to a local JSON file (absolute, relative to the project root, or a file:// URL).

apiPathKey.description: Path prefix that selects which API paths are generated; the prefix is stripped before grouping and method naming. Defaults to '/api/'.

baseApiTemplatePath.description: Custom template path for base API generation.

framework.description: Target framework for generated API code: 'angular' or 'react-rtk'. Required, no default; may come from openapi-schematics.json.

scopeEndpointsWithTags.description: Whether to scope endpoint names with tags for RTK Query. When true, generates names like 'postsGetAll' instead of 'getAll'. Recommended for APIs with multiple controllers to avoid naming collisions.

typeMapping.description: Map custom backend types to TypeScript primitives. Keys are schema names, values are TypeScript types (e.g., { 'SuperDuperInt32': 'number', 'CustomGuid': 'string' }).

templateHelpersPath.description: Path to a JavaScript file exporting custom helper functions for use in templates. The exported functions and values will be available in the template context.

eslintFix.description: Run the host project's ESLint with autofix on generated files, using the project's own configuration (import sorting, commas, quotes, etc.). Never blocks generation: failures are reported as warnings and files keep their generated content.

legacyOptionalProperties.description: Legacy optionality: mark an interface property optional ('?') when it is nullable instead of when it is absent from the object schema's 'required' array. Escape hatch for back-ends that do not emit 'required' yet. Nullability ('| null' in the type) is unaffected.

removeStaleFiles.description: Delete files generated by a previous run whose schema or endpoint group is no longer in the API document. Only files listed in the '.swagger-schematics-manifest.json' this package keeps in 'path' are ever removed; hand-written files are never touched. Defaults to true; set false to keep such files (they are listed as warnings).

schemaSnapshotPath.description: Path of a copy of the schema saved by 'swagger-schematics all', relative to the project root (a leading '/' is allowed, like 'path'), e.g. '/src/app/core/openapi.snapshot.json'. Commit it with the generated code: the next run compares the new schema with it and prints the API changes (see --change-report). CLI 'all' command only.

rtkCacheTags.description: React RTK only: generate RTK Query cache tags, one per API slice. Queries provide their slice's tag and mutations invalidate it, so a list refetches after a create/update/delete in the same slice. The tags are the members of a generated TApiTag enum ('api-tag.enum.ts' in 'path'). Defaults to false.

includeApis.description: Generate only these APIs: controller names as they appear in the path (e.g. 'Orders' for /api/Orders/...), case-insensitive, '*' as a wildcard. On the CLI, comma-separated. Unset or empty: every API is generated.

excludeApis.description: Skip these APIs (same matching as includeApis), e.g. ['Admin', 'Internal*']. On the CLI, comma-separated.

excludeDeprecated.description: Skip operations marked 'deprecated' (e.g. .NET [Obsolete] endpoints). Defaults to false.
